toolbar.help:
Copy… (F5)
Copies the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the target panel's folder, or to a place you choose.

Move / rename… (F6)
Moves the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the target panel's folder, or renames them.

Delete… (F8)
Moves the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the Recycle Bin or trash; Shift+Del deletes permanently.

Back (Alt+Left)
Goes back to the folder this tab showed before.
Unavailable here: No earlier location in this tab.

Copy… (F5)
Copies the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the target panel's folder, or to a place you choose.

Move / rename… (F6)
Moves the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the target panel's folder, or renames them.
Unavailable here: Drives cannot be moved: open a drive (Enter) to move what is on it. Use F5 to copy instead.

Delete… (F8)
Moves the marked items (or the one under the cursor) to the Recycle Bin or trash; Shift+Del deletes permanently.
Unavailable here: Drives are not deleted from here: open a drive (Enter) to delete what is on it.

Back (Alt+Left)
Goes back to the folder this tab showed before.
